meta.title: Two vocabularies
meta.question: Where does the vendor have a word and the customer none?
caveats: Vendor terms are Claude's (INFERRED); customer wording is the instrument's (VERBATIM).
Answer words are the most frequent content words in answers carrying the concept (lexicon alpha 0.72, usable with caution).
A gap is a concept with no customer-side word in the instrument; naming it is Scott's (Q-S10a).
